summary: outcome: unchanged · criteria unchanged [C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C11, C12, C13, C14, C16, C17, C18, I1, I2, I3] changed [C15] added [-] removed [-]
contract:
schema: goal/v1
id: dogfood-buildout
title: 'v0.2.0: reliable verification, amendable contracts, goal identity at scale'
intent:
  verbatim: 'you need to rework and replan out the full dogfood-buildout goal and make sure you include EVERYTHING we have discussed and the shape of the full goal to be updated into a new dogfood-buildout goal with all the updates and changes and improvements and findings to include teh full scope'
why: >-
  Everything discussed so far converges here: the dogfood defects (T013-T016), both council
  verdicts (contract integrity; identity/versioning/lifecycle), the v0.3 epic (registry,
  help, CLEO link), the untested engine paths, and the single v0.2.0 release — executed and
  proven under the goal loop itself, with CLEO as the decomposition source of truth.
outcome: >-
  opencode-goal v0.2.0 is tagged on GitHub and proven: the verifier always yields a verdict
  (tool call or parsed fallback), counters stay live during long executions, /goal start
  refuses to lock unrehearsed broken checks, owners can amend a live contract through an
  audited re-lock, goals carry registry-backed identity with archive and supersession,
  admission search blocks duplicate intent, /goal help guides agents, the untested paths
  are covered by host scenarios, and this run's own verified completion is the final proof.
non_goals:
  - 'Relay mode, goal queues, home-screen board, Claude Code / Codex adapters, headless runner (HANDOFF §9.6 remainder)'
  - 'npm publishing — git install only'
  - 'Any change to the owner''s global OpenCode plugin install during the run; reinstall is manual after'
  - 'A hard CLEO dependency — the CLEO link stays optional and CLI-only'
  - 'Staged/intermediate release tags — one v0.2.0 end release (owner decision)'
criteria:
  - id: C1
    statement: >-
      Verifier reliability (T016): a prose-answering verifier child still yields a parsed
      fallback verdict, the hardened prompt demands exactly one goal_verdict call, and the
      child transcript is persisted under evidence/
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/verifier-reliability.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C2
    statement: >-
      Live counters (T013): usage and turn state update between usage events instead of
      freezing at kickoff values, and never render the sentinel 1
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/live-counters.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C3
    statement: >-
      parse.ts warns when a command check spans lines (the folded-scalar class that broke
      run 0ffe5ac6e001 C3) — T021
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/unit/contract.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: C4
    statement: >-
      Start-time rehearsal (T036): /goal start executes each command check once, records
      the baseline, and refuses to lock a contract whose check text is unrunnable
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/rehearsal.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C5
    statement: >-
      goal_amend (T037+T038): owner-approved re-lock with generation-bound amendment
      records, write guard covering stopped states, integrity message naming real paths
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/amend.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C6
    statement: >-
      Registry (T026): a derived machine-level index updates on transitions, rebuilds by
      scan to identical content, and lists goals across projects
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/unit/registry.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: C7
    statement: >-
      Archive tier (T032): /goal archive demotes without deleting; existence still answers
      yes from the registry; the live list excludes archived goals
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/archive.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C8
    statement: >-
      Supersession (T031): supersedes pointer, terminal predecessor, mid-flight admission
      rule — approving a successor of a non-terminal predecessor is blocked or explicitly
      acknowledged
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/supersede.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C9
    statement: >-
      Admission search (T033): existence and title/intent similarity probes run before a
      new slug is formed, surfacing similar goals ranked
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/unit/similarity.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: C10
    statement: >-
      /goal help (T025): an agent-forward guide — commands with arguments, worker/owner
      tool split, storage layout, mid-run rules — rendered from a pure builder
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/unit/help.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: C11
    statement: >-
      CLEO link (T027): when .cleo is present the goal records the CLEO project linkage via
      CLI only; absent CLEO changes nothing
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/unit/cleo-link.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: C12
    statement: >-
      Untested paths (T040+T041): budget wrap-up, goal_wait timer, diff/absent checks, human
      approval, compaction hook, session.deleted, provider errors — host scenarios — plus
      synthetic continuation notices
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test test/host/paths.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: C13
    statement: >-
      design.md (T029) records both council decisions — rehearsal + amendment (145323Z) and
      keep-descriptive-slugs/supersession/archive (162655Z) — in the as-built table
    check:
      kind: contains
      path: docs/design.md
      regex: '(?=.*start-time rehearsal)(?=.*supersedes)(?=.*descriptive slug)'
  - id: C14
    statement: >-
      The v0.2.0 tag installs from git in an isolated OpenCode (single end release, T043)
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'OCGOAL_GIT_INSTALL=1 OCGOAL_GIT_SPEC="github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.2.0" bun test test/host/git-install.test.ts'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      live: true
      timeout: 600
  - id: C15
    statement: package.json is bumped for the release
    check:
      kind: contains
      path: package.json
      text: '"version": "0.2.2"'
  - id: C16
    statement: CHANGELOG.md has the v0.2.0 entry
    check:
      kind: contains
      path: CHANGELOG.md
      text: 0.2.0
  - id: C17
    statement: 'docs/dogfood-2.md exists and quotes a real verifier round (goal_verdict or recorded fallback) — T042'
    check:
      kind: contains
      path: docs/dogfood-2.md
      regex: 'goal_verdict'
  - id: C18
    statement: >-
      The dogfood-2 findings are grounded: every claim traceable to this run's
      ledger/evidence, defects filed as CLEO tasks with ids
    check:
      kind: verifier
      ask: >-
        Read docs/dogfood-2.md and this run's .opencode/goals/dogfood-buildout/ledger.jsonl
        and evidence/. Judge: does the doc ground its claims in the ledger/evidence
        (continuation behaviour, a successful verifier round with real quotes or a recorded
        fallback verdict, cost and prompt-cache observations, amendment/supersession
        exercised where applicable), and are defects filed as CLEO tasks with their ids
        listed? List anything missing or unsupported.
invariants:
  - id: I1
    statement: The full test suite SHALL CONTINUE TO pass
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun test'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
      timeout: 600
  - id: I2
    statement: The typecheck SHALL CONTINUE TO pass
    check:
      kind: command
      run: 'bun run typecheck'
      expect: { exit: 0 }
  - id: I3
    statement: >-
      The observed-behaviour oracle, the test harness and both council audit trails SHALL
      NOT change
    check:
      kind: diff
      paths: ['docs/spikes.md', 'test/host/harness.ts', '.cleo/council-runs']
protect: ['docs/spikes.md', 'test/host/harness.ts', '.cleo/council-runs/**']
scope:
  in:
    - 'Engine: verifier fallback + transcripts (T016), live counters (T013), parse warning (T021)'
    - 'Integrity: rehearsal (T036), stopped-state guard + message (T037), goal_amend (T038)'
    - 'Identity: registry (T026), archive (T032), supersession (T031), admission search (T033)'
    - 'Surfaces: /goal help (T025), CLEO link (T027), OpenCode DB spike verdict (T028 into T029)'
    - 'Coverage: untested paths (T040), synthetic notices (T041), tui-smoke probes (T014), trigger-eval command route (T015)'
    - 'Closeout: design fold-in (T029), release v0.2.0 (T043), dogfood-2 (T042), CLEO completes'
  out:
    - 'Everything in non_goals'
constraints:
  - 'OpenCode 2 only; plain-object default export; @opencode/* imports are types only'
  - 'Keep the system block byte-stable within a run; volatile status goes in the per-turn tail note'
  - 'Every behaviour change to the loop gets a host scenario'
  - 'Commits: type(T###): summary — every commit references a CLEO task (hooks enforce)'
  - 'setup can run twice per location; everything registered must be disposed in stop()'
  - 'Every command check stays on a single line and is rehearsed before any claim (lesson from run 0ffe5ac6e001)'
plan:
  - {id: S1, title: 'Verifier reliability: harden, fenced-JSON fallback, persist transcripts (T016)', proves: [C1]}
  - {id: S2, title: 'Live counters between usage events (T013)', proves: [C2]}
  - {id: S3, title: 'parse.ts multi-line command warning + unit test (T021)', proves: [C3]}
  - {id: S4, title: 'Start-time rehearsal at /goal start + baseline capture (T036)', proves: [C4], depends_on: [S3]}
  - {id: S5, title: 'Write guard across stopped states + integrity message fix (T037)', proves: [C5]}
  - {id: S6, title: 'goal_amend: owner-approved re-lock, generation records (T038)', proves: [C5], depends_on: [S5]}
  - {id: S7, title: 'Registry: derived index, rebuild parity, cross-project list (T026)', proves: [C6]}
  - {id: S8, title: 'Archive tier: demote never delete, existence survives (T032)', proves: [C7], depends_on: [S7]}
  - {id: S9, title: 'Supersession: pointer, terminal predecessor, mid-flight rule (T031)', proves: [C8], depends_on: [S6, S7]}
  - {id: S10, title: 'Admission-time existence + fuzzy similarity (T033)', proves: [C9], depends_on: [S7]}
  - {id: S11, title: '/goal help agent-forward builder (T025)', proves: [C10]}
  - {id: S12, title: 'CLEO optional link via CLI (T027); T028 spike verdict recorded', proves: [C11]}
  - {id: S13, title: 'Untested paths scenarios (T040) + synthetic continuation notices (T041)', proves: [C12], depends_on: [S1]}
  - {id: S14, title: 'Design fold-in (T029); close T014 tui-smoke probes and T015 trigger eval', proves: [C13], depends_on: [S4, S5, S6, S7, S8, S9]}
  - {id: S15, title: 'Release v0.2.0: bump, changelog, tag, push, git-install test (T043)', proves: [C14, C15, C16], depends_on: [S14]}
  - {id: S16, title: 'dogfood-2.md from this run (T042); CLEO completes T012/T017/T018/T022', proves: [C17, C18], depends_on: [S15]}
assumptions:
  - id: A1
    text: >-
      The old run 0ffe5ac6e001 (needs_review) is aborted by the owner before this contract
      starts; its ledger and evidence remain on disk as history this contract appends to
    rationale: the engine refuses a second non-terminal goal in one session; only the owner aborts
    reversible: false
  - id: A2
    text: 'Single end release: exactly one tag (v0.2.0) when all criteria are green; no staged tags'
    rationale: owner decision 2026-10-03
    reversible: true
  - id: A3
    text: >-
      A fenced-JSON verdict from the verifier child is accepted as equivalent to a
      goal_verdict call and recorded distinctly (by: verifier-fallback)
    rationale: owner decision — the fallback exists so a silent child cannot kill a round
    reversible: true
  - id: A4
    text: >-
      CLEO stays the decomposition source of truth: each plan step completes its mapped task
      with evidence atoms before the step is done; the correlation table lives in context.md
    rationale: owner directive 2026-10-03
    reversible: false
  - id: A5
    text: >-
      OpenCode''s internal DB stays read-only and spike-gated; the registry stores its own
      file regardless of the T028 verdict
    rationale: schema is internal to OpenCode; re-invention limited to the derived index
    reversible: true
stop:
  escalate_when:
    - 'An amendment or supersession semantic cannot be settled from the council conditions — stop with the design question'
    - 'The verifier is still unreliable on the real provider after the fallback — file the defect and stop'
    - 'git push or the tag is rejected, or the git-install test fails against the pushed v0.2.0'
    - 'An OpenCode update changes the internal DB schema the read-only probe depends on'
verification:
  mode: host+verifier
  max_rejections: 3
autonomy:
  questions: defer
  on_user_message: steer
  on_interrupt: pause
